title: [CRY-2] Sealed-envelope AEAD has no nonce rule, under a key shared by every member for the whole e
description: Review finding CRY-2: Sealed-envelope AEAD has no nonce rule, under a key shared by every member for the whole epoch (lens CRY). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:214-220. Fix: The text defines the key (`MLS-Exporter("agora sealed envelope", channelCID, Nk)`) and the AAD but no nonce and no byte layout. The word "nonce" appears in §5 only for broadcast (05:141-144). Every member shares the key for the whole epoch, so any deterministic per-sender nonce collides across senders under AES-128-GCM. Define `sealedEnvelope = nonce(12, random) || AEAD-Seal(...)`, mirroring 05:141-144. One correction to the suggested fix: no single sender can count seals across all members, so a "new epoch before 2^32 seals" rule cannot be enforced. Make the bound a per-sender SHOULD, and rely on the §12.2 7-day epoch cap for the aggregate. Full text: notes/review/CRY-verified.md and notes/review/CRY.md.
